$comment: Label set of the public issue tracker (docs/sla.md §9.2; support automation tools/support/sla.ts; issue forms .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE). Synced by `tools/support/run labels --apply`; labels are created or updated, never deleted.

labels.name: type:bug
labels.description: Something does not work as documented

labels.name: type:service
labels.description: The hosted service is down, slow or not counting (reported from the status page)

labels.name: type:support
labels.description: Integration or usage help (support clock applies)

labels.name: type:enrolment
labels.description: Sign-up, domain, registry or contract verification

labels.name: type:feature
labels.description: Feature request: resolved by a decision

labels.name: priority:p1
labels.description: Service down or data at risk

labels.name: tenant
labels.description: Raised by or about a tenant project

labels.name: security
labels.description: Security-related: details belong in a private advisory

labels.name: privacy
labels.description: Privacy process (no personal data in public)

labels.name: sla:awaiting-first-response
labels.description: No maintainer response yet (target: 5 business days)

labels.name: sla:response-breach
labels.description: First response took 5 business days or more (never removed)

labels.name: sla:resolution-breach
labels.description: Open 10 business days or more (never removed)

labels.name: sla:exempt
labels.description: Not a support ticket (maintainers' tracking issue); reviewable

labels.name: status:needs-info
labels.description: Waiting for the reporter: support clock paused
